name: Progress monitoring and reporting commitment

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraph 4.31 — ongoing monitoring and reporting against the improvement plan); Chapter 5: Disclosures

summary: Tests whether the developer has committed to monitoring progress against the improvement plan and reporting outcomes at least annually. PS23/16 ¶4.31 requires ongoing reporting; PB methodology v3.5 aligned band requires (a) annual cadence, (b) reporting against the c7 quantified targets explicitly (not generic ESG narrative), and (c) a stated verification mechanism (third-party assurance or independent technical audit). Partially_aligned for annual cadence without verification commitment.
